services.name: Bike Oconomowoc
services.desc: This webpage contains detailed information about bike routes in the Oconomowoc area. The webpage is a compliment to an Oconomowoc-area bike map that was first published in summer of 2016. This overall map shows all routes you can ride throughout the area which lead to downtown Oconomowoc. Just like all spokes on a bicycle wheel meet at the center of the wheel, these "spokes" all lead to Oconomowoc's downtown where you will find racks to park your bike (look for the rack icons on the downtown map). While there you can explore and enjoy local businesses, area parks and attractions. Features: This spoke explores the north part of the City with an option to stop at Nature Hill recreation area
